about_description: A clean local game launcher: multi-server download, update and preload; light/dark themes.
launch_environmentHint: One KEY=VALUE per line; values support the {installDir} placeholder.
launch_serverHint: Switching servers refreshes version and install state instantly (each server keeps its own install directory)
launch_installDirHint: Absolute path, or relative to the install root; applies on save.
launch_executableHint: Relative to the install directory or absolute; if you already have the game from another source, pick its executable to launch directly without re-downloading.
launch_umuNotInstalled: umu-launcher not found (the most reliable way to run Windows games on Linux; manages the Steam Runtime for you)
launch_windowsDefaultHint: On Windows the game starts directly via the official method; no compatibility layer needed.
launch_workingDirectoryHint: Leave empty to use the game install directory.
message_configCreated: Default config created at {0}. See docs/GAME_CONFIG.md to add more games.
message_launchMigrated: Linux launch templates upgraded to the community-recommended setup (umu-launcher → Proton → wine).
settings_appBackground_failed: Failed to set the background: file not found or the config could not be saved
settings_appBackground_hint: Background image for the settings and about pages (also used behind the sidebar); leave empty for the built-in gradient. Game detail page backdrops are not affected.
settings_appearanceHint: Theme and language changes apply immediately and are saved to the config file.
settings_autostartFailed: Failed to change the autostart setting, please retry
settings_configFileHint: Edit games.json to add new games or servers; restart the launcher to apply.
settings_installRootEdit: Edit the install root here; changes apply immediately on save.
settings_installRootSaved: Install root updated; game paths re-resolved
status_launchNotReady: Game executable not found: install first, or check the path under Game Settings → Launch.
status_noConnection: Cannot reach the server, version info unavailable
status_detected: Existing game files detected, ready to launch
verify_confirm_msg: This game has no per-file manifest, so verify & repair will re-download the full package (~{0}) and reinstall over the existing files. Continue?
verify_confirm_msg_nosize: This game has no per-file manifest, so verify & repair will re-download the full package and reinstall over the existing files. Continue?
gacha_status_noUrl: No convene URL found in game logs: open the Convene History page in-game once, then come back and refresh (the URL is valid for about 1 hour).
gacha_status_fetched: Fetched {0} new records (merged into local history)
gacha_status_failed: Fetch failed: the URL may have expired — open Convene History in-game again and retry.
settings_proxySaved: Proxy settings saved and applied instantly
settings_proxyInvalid: Manual proxy requires a valid http(s)://host:port address
settings_proxyHint: Applies to version checks, downloads, backdrops and convene history; changes take effect immediately after save.
